subject: Re: Amendment to add-on allocation and split billing for June term
messages:
From: Erin Sullivan <erin@heliomaps.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@heliomaps.com
Date: 2026-06-22T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Request: adjust add-on allocation mid-term (June)

Hi Priya —

We're running into a short-term need: two of our field teams went live ahead of schedule and we need to reassign 30 of our reserved annotation seats from the "Analytics" group to the "Field Ops" add-on for the remainder of June (billing period ends 2026-06-30).

Can Redwood do a partial reallocation mid-cycle and how would you handle invoicing? Specifically:
- We want the 30-seat allocation to move today, June 22, through June 30 only.
- We'd like a single line item on our June billing that reflects the pro-rated charge rather than a credit + separate invoice if possible.
- HelioMaps is EU-registered (VAT ID in PO). If there's any VAT treatment (reverse charge vs. standard VAT) please confirm.

I've attached our PO and the current invoice for reference.

Thanks — Erin
Erin Sullivan
Head of Operations, HelioMaps Inc.
attachment: Helio_PO_20260622.pdf (pdf)
attachment: Current_invoice_20260601.pdf (pdf)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Sullivan <erin@heliomaps.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-22T11:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: adjust add-on allocation mid-term (June)

Hi Erin — thanks for the note and the PO. We can accommodate that request; two high-level options that might work depending on your accounting preference:

Option A — Single consolidated June invoice (your preference):
- We will calculate a prorated charge for 30 add-on seats for 9 days (22–30 Jun) and add a single invoice line on your existing June invoice.
- Internally we apply the daily pro-rate on the monthly unit price and surface the calculation in the invoice narrative.
- VAT: because you provided a VAT ID in the PO and this is a B2B EU transaction, we expect reverse-charge to apply. We will put the VAT ID on the invoice and omit EU VAT, with the appropriate reverse-charge note. Please confirm the VAT ID exactly as it appears on your company tax records.

Option B — Credit + separate pro-rated debit: simpler for bookkeeping in some cases. We issue a credit for the cancelled allocation and a short-term debit for the add-on. Both will net to the same amount but appear as two line items.

Can you confirm: 30 seats moving on 2026-06-22 through 2026-06-30 inclusive, and include the VAT ID text you want shown on the invoice? If you confirm, I'll loop in Laura from billing to generate the line and draft the invoice.

I copied Ben (account lead) so he can coordinate the access change and ensure the seats are reallocated in the console immediately after billing action.

Best —
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Erin Sullivan <erin@heliomaps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-23T09:28:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: adjust add-on allocation mid-term (June)

Hi Erin / Priya —

Thanks Priya. Erin — attaching a draft stub of the credit/debit layout for transparency (draft_credit_note_stub.pdf). We can implement Option A (single consolidated line) as requested. Details below: 

Calculation summary:
- Monthly unit price (HelioMaps add-on seat): EUR 45.00 / seat / month
- Prorate factor: 9 days / 30-day cycle = 0.3
- Charge: 30 seats * EUR 45 * 0.3 = EUR 405.00

Invoice treatment:
- We will append a single invoice line: "Add-on allocation (30 seats) — prorated 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-30" with net EUR 405.00.
- VAT: We will include your VAT ID as provided on the invoice and apply reverse-charge (no EU VAT collected). The invoice narrative will include the reverse-charge clause and your VAT number. If you prefer VAT charged, note that will change the gross amount and we will need an override from your finance team.
- Payment: This will be on the normal 30-day terms for June invoice. If you need accelerated collection for this line only, let us know and we can issue an interim invoice.

Operational steps for seat move:
- Ben will trigger the seat reallocation in the console now; access will change immediately. Billing adjustment will be reflected today and will appear on your June invoice PDF (INV-20260601-HELIOMAPS).

I'll queue the invoice update and attach the revised invoice once generated (expected within 24 hours).

Laura Bennett
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
